text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While working in the trainer's office,
Sakura Chiyono O burst in with great energy.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
I really think that "mikan mandarins are Umamusume"!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Even if you have a whole cardboard box full of mikan,
if you eat them bit by bit, they'll get ruined by mold in no time, won't they?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That is why seasonal foods should be enjoyed in season!
Meaning we should eat plenty of them when they're at their most delicious!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And so, would you happen to have
any free time sometime this weekend?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it is now December.
And when it comes to this season's specialties—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Christmas, of course!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Trainer!
Look at the pretty illuminations over there!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, a winter sale too!
Want to take a peek together?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, of course!
I figured I have to enjoy it to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Because peak season is over
in the blink of an eye, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: If it's something we can only enjoy for a limited time, I felt like we should make the most of it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Besides, as long as Trainer is with me,
I feel like I can have a mature Christmas.
Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Aah, don't play dumb with me!
Take me to fancy cafes that kids can't go to
every once in a while~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I want to fully enjoy a Christmas outside of places like arcades or shopping malls, you know~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Since she had suddenly started throwing a tantrum,
I searched for a place I could take her right away.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...D-Doesn't this place feel
a little too fancy for us...?

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text: What would you like to drink?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: U-Um... milk tea, please.

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, certainly.
Please make yourself at home.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Whew... Sakura Chiyono O,
feels like she took a step up the staircase to adulthood."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah. This song...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The catchy, pleasant song was a Christmas tune
commonly heard playing on street corners.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It's a song I hear all the time,
yet listening to it here makes it feel special somehow.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
This is a special place I've never known,
so maybe there's even a spell that stops time.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"If only Christmas could last forever like this.
Without next year ever coming, just repeating the same time over and over."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, indeed.
I have come to accept that as well.

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Here is your milk tea, esteemed guest.
I shall leave it right here on the table for you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wah, th-thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And the milk tea I ordered just arrived, too.
choice_data_list: Because time is always moving forward, there's always something to be gained.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Do you mean that milk tea?
choice_data_list: Right, have your drink before it gets cold.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...It's sweet, yet refreshing.
choice_data_list: That flavor was only possible because time moved forward.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...!
...Fufu, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Listening to the Christmas songs,
Sakura Chiyono O drank down
her milk tea to the last drop.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And the milk tea I ordered just arrived, too.
choice_data_list: Because time is always moving forward, there's always something to be gained.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Do you mean that milk tea?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... So cold.
It's gotten really chilly outside, hasn't it~?
choice_data_list: It was warm inside, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes... wait, what?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, so pretty... Look, over here!
The illuminations are totally different from during the day...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. This is another sight I could only see
because time is moving...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
......I see.
It's so pretty...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san is an adult, after all.
You know so many more things than I do.
choice_data_list: Because I'm an adult, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, as time keeps marching on,
I suppose I'll gradually grow into an adult too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If I can grow up to be an adult like you, Trainer,
then maybe looking forward to it isn't so bad.
